citation: Government Notice No. 255 of 2017 — The Forest (Amendments) Regulations, 2017 (made under s. 106 of the Forest Act, Cap. 323)
renumberingNote: Cites s. 106 as printed at publication. In Cap. 323 R.E. 2023 the regulation-making power appears at s. 107 (see card a107). The as-printed citation is kept; it is not modernised.
commencementNote: No express commencement provision; publication date recorded, commencement not asserted.
nameCollisionWarning: This is NOT the same instrument as GN 255 of 2023 (Chain B). They share a notice number but are entirely separate instruments.
